name: Hull shell
info: H80 foam strip-plank, 2 x 6 oz glass outside, 1 x 6 oz inside. Hi-vis topsides, boot stripe, copper antifouling below the waterline.

name: Transom
info: 10 mm H80 with 2 + 1 plies; carries the stern-post bracket P06.

name: Deck
info: 10 mm H80, 2 x 6 oz out / 1 in, non-skid. Bonded and taped to the hull.

name: Hatch lid
info: Bolted with 12 x M5 into bonded inserts on 4 mm EPDM cord. Carries the RockBLOCK bowl P23, a membrane vent and a Schrader test valve.

name: Solar panel 1
info: Rev E3: PV Logic STPVF010 10 W ETFE flexi panel, 380 x 250 x 4, bonded in its deck bay; 20 W in all (run 027: no measurable cost).

name: Solar panel 2
info: Rev E3: PV Logic STPVF010 10 W ETFE flexi panel, 380 x 250 x 4, bonded in its deck bay; 20 W in all (run 027: no measurable cost).

name: YB3 well
info: Glassed well in the foredeck, 176 x 106 x 38, drains aft.

name: Keel fin
info: NACA 0012, 170/150 chord, 430 deep. Hardwood core, carbon strip and 6 x 6 oz each side; 60 mm tenon into the keel box, two M10 rods.

name: Lead bulb
info: Cast lead, D72 x 320, about 9.2 kg, from pattern P14 in a plaster mould. Slotted onto the fin tip.

name: Weed fairing
info: XPS + glass ramp from the fin leading edge to the bulb nose, so weed and line slide off.

name: Wing sail
info: NACA 0015, 375 chord x 800 span, XPS core with 2 x 6 oz glass and 3 mm ply end caps. Free-pivoting on the spar 82 mm from the leading edge.

name: Wing spar
info: Carbon tube 30 x 22, 995 long, on two 6806 acetal bearings in P07 (open item: special-order size).

name: Tail boom
info: Carbon tube 16 x 14 (Rev E1), spar axis to tail pivot 600.

name: Counterweight arm
info: 12 mm solid pultruded fibreglass rod, 244 long (Rev C3).

name: Counterweight lead
info: About 0.91 kg of lead shot in epoxy inside P18.

name: Tail pivot rod
info: 6 mm carbon rod through both tail halves.

name: P07 Mast bearing housing
info: Bonded into the top of the mast tube; two floating 6806 acetal bearings and plain catcher lands.

name: P08 Spar clamp
info: Clamps the spar; takes the tail boom aft and the counterweight arm forward.

name: P09 Tail servo housing
info: On the aft end of the boom; holds the potted tail servo output-up.

name: P10 Tail fin, lower
info: NACA 0012, 120 chord, printed and glassed; bonded to the servo horn.

name: P10 Tail fin, upper
info: Upper half, joined with the pivot rod and a 3 mm carbon pin.

name: P25 Tail detent
info: Two magnets that hold the tail at +/-8 deg if its servo dies.

name: P18 Counterweight pod
info: Holds about 0.91 kg of lead; balances the wing and tail on the spar axis.

name: Stern post
info: 20 x 2 pultruded fibreglass tube, 500 long (Rev C3): bends rather than kinks.

name: Radar reflector
info: Davis Emergency Radar Reflector 151, lashed to the post at z 330-470.

name: P06 Transom bracket
info: Bolted through the transom with 4 x M5; two M4 set screws grip the post.

name: P05 Antenna platform
info: Main GPS + compass (Holybro Micro M10) bonded under the plate.

name: Main GPS (Micro M10)
info: Holybro Micro M10 GPS + IST8310 compass, potted in soft silicone.

name: P20 Nav light clamp
info: All-round white light on a 45 mm arm.

name: Navigation light
info: 12 V all-round white LED puck.

name: P03 Sensor cap
info: Caps the post; carries the AS5600 board under the vane magnet.

name: P01 Wind-vane housing
info: Two S608 stainless bearings and spacer P27 in one D22.1 bore (E2).

name: P27 Vane bearing spacer
info: Between the two vane bearings (E2).

name: S608-2RS bearing
info: Stainless 8 x 22 x 7.

name: S608-2RS bearing
info: Stainless 8 x 22 x 7.

name: P04 Magnet holder
info: Diametric magnet on the end of the vane shaft, over the AS5600.

name: Vane shaft
info: 8 mm 316 stainless.

name: P02 Wind-vane arm
info: Vane arm with fin and lead counterweight; hub set-screwed to the shaft.

name: P23 RockBLOCK bowl
info: Bonded into a D146 hole in the hatch lid; holds the RockBLOCK Plus with 4 x M5.

name: RockBLOCK Plus
info: Iridium SBD modem, IP67 puck; RS-232 to the main box.

name: P19 YB3 platform
info: In the foredeck well; straps hold the YB3.

name: YB3 tracker
info: Independent backup tracker with its own battery and Iridium link.

name: Membrane vent
info: Amphenol M12 IP68 vent: pressure equalisation without water.

name: Schrader test valve
info: For the pressure-decay leak test; capped at sea.

name: Pump outlet fitting
info: 1/4 in through-deck fitting, after a check valve and a loop to z 226.

name: Mast tube
info: 2 in. schedule 40 PVC, glassed to hull and deck; P07 bonds into its top.

name: P13 Rudder core, upper (port)
info: Printed core, 2 x 6 oz glass over it, pinned to the 12 mm stock with two 4 mm pins.

name: P13 Rudder core, lower (port)
info: Lower half of the rudder blade.

name: Rudder stock (port)
info: 12 mm 316 bar, 360 long.

name: Rudder trunk (port)
info: 316 tube 16 x 1 (or GRP, 14 ID) with two igus JFM-1214 bushings.

name: P11 Tiller arm (port)
info: Clamped and pinned to the stock; pushrod holes at 35/45/55.

name: P12 Servo cradle (port)
info: Holds the sealed SER-2000 servo output-up in the aft-foam pocket (E2 base fits the pocket).

name: SER-2000 sealed servo (port)
info: Blue Trail SER-2000 housing around a DFRobot 25 kg magnetic-encoder servo (size is an estimate).

name: P26 Servo arm (port)
info: Clamps the SER-2000's 6 mm D-shaft; holes at 20/25/30.

name: Pushrod + spring link (port)
info: M2 316 rod with the spring overload link (D32).

name: P13 Rudder core, upper (stbd)
info: Printed core, 2 x 6 oz glass over it, pinned to the 12 mm stock with two 4 mm pins.

name: P13 Rudder core, lower (stbd)
info: Lower half of the rudder blade.

info: 12 mm 316 bar, 360 long.

name: Rudder trunk (stbd)

name: P11 Tiller arm (stbd)
info: Clamped and pinned to the stock; pushrod holes at 35/45/55.

name: P12 Servo cradle (stbd)
info: Holds the sealed SER-2000 servo output-up in the aft-foam pocket (E2 base fits the pocket).

name: SER-2000 sealed servo (stbd)
info: Blue Trail SER-2000 housing around a DFRobot 25 kg magnetic-encoder servo (size is an estimate).

name: P26 Servo arm (stbd)
info: Clamps the SER-2000's 6 mm D-shaft; holes at 20/25/30.

name: Pushrod + spring link (stbd)
info: M2 316 rod with the spring overload link (D32).

name: Bulkhead x 300
info: 10 mm H80, glassed in with 50 mm tapes both sides (T17/T18).

name: Bulkhead x 1260
info: 10 mm H80, glassed in with 50 mm tapes both sides (T17/T18).

name: Floor x 650
info: 9 mm marine ply floor across the hull at the keel box.

name: Floor x 800
info: 9 mm marine ply floor across the hull at the keel box.

name: Keel box
info: Glass socket cast round the waxed fin tenon, 60 deep.

name: G10 plate + fin rods
info: 122 x 60 x 10 G10 taking the two M10 rod nuts.

name: M10 fin rod
info: M10 316 threaded rod bedded in the fin.

name: M10 fin rod
info: M10 316 threaded rod bedded in the fin.

name: Bow foam fill
info: Sealed compartment ahead of bulkhead x 300, filled with XPS blocks.

name: Stern foam fill
info: Sealed compartment aft of bulkhead x 1260, XPS with fitted pockets for the two servos.

name: P24 Bilge-pump spacer
info: Holds the diaphragm pump upright against the port side of the mast tube.

name: Bilge pump
info: 12 V R385 diaphragm pump, self-priming, pickup at the sump low point.

name: P17 Penetrator pad
info: Flat seat for a WetLink penetrator on a curved or thin wall.

info: Flat seat for a WetLink penetrator on a curved or thin wall.

info: Flat seat for a WetLink penetrator on a curved or thin wall.

name: Battery box
info: Sealed 10 mm H80 box with an O-ring lid, strapped down on P16; lifts out through the hatch.

name: Battery 12.8 V 15 Ah
info: Bioenno BLF-1215A LiFePO4, PVC pack.

name: P16 Battery strap anchor
info: Four anchors glassed to the hull floor take the battery-box straps.

name: P16 Battery strap anchor
info: Four anchors glassed to the hull floor take the battery-box straps.

name: P16 Battery strap anchor
info: Four anchors glassed to the hull floor take the battery-box straps.

name: P16 Battery strap anchor
info: Four anchors glassed to the hull floor take the battery-box straps.

name: Electronics shelf
info: Glassed foam shelf: box bottom at z 118, 70 mm above the sump.

name: Electronics box
info: Hammond 1554V2GYCL, IP68 polycarbonate.

name: Electronics box lid
info: Clear lid with cable glands and a membrane vent.

name: P15 Electronics tray
info: Slotted tray for zip ties and Dual Lock inside the box.

name: Pixhawk 6C Mini
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: Companion ESP32-S3
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: Genasun GV-5 MPPT
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: PM02 power module
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: 6 V / 5 V regulators
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: MAX3232 + INA260s
info: Inside the sealed main box (D30).

name: P21 Limp-home case
info: Potted limp-home controller (own ESP32, GPS, BNO085, fused feed) on bulkhead x 300.

name: P22 Switchover pod
info: Servo multiplexer and ideal diodes, potted, on bulkhead x 1260.
